card_mismatch.title: Eco-Home: unexpected {id_kind} card on {device_name}
card_mismatch.description:
The heat pump **{device_name}** ({device_code}) reported card `{card_id}`. This integration knows that card as the {id_kind} card, but its contents indicate a {mode_kind} card.

To make sure the wrong function is never switched or adjusted, the integration ignores this card. The {id_kind} entity therefore stays missing or unavailable until this is resolved. This warning disappears automatically once the heat pump reports a consistent card again.

If this warning persists, please [open an issue]({issue_tracker}) and include the card data below. The Home Assistant log contains a warning with the data of all cards as well.

`{card}`
